_comment: Realistic mock of a single OpenWeather observation after normalisation by OpenWeatherProducer._build_raw_payload(). Represents a STATIC mode observation for the Taipei hotspot (strategic_tag='taiwan_semiconductor') on 2026-04-02. wind_speed_ms is raw m/s from OWM wind.speed — Silver Job converts to knots via x1.94384. weather_id=502 (heavy intensity rain) maps to condition_severity=4 via CONDITION_ID_TO_SEVERITY, triggering Natural_Disaster_Alert and Tech_Supply_Risk in the Gold Job. Section 4.4 / Section C.1 / Section B.6.
